description:
Let a person see, change or delete their saved searches and email alerts. For privacy they are not
listed in the chat: PropertyList emails the person a link that logs them in (no password) and opens
their saved searches on PropertyList, where they can change or delete each one. Tell them to check
their email. Each alert email also has a link to stop that alert.
name: manage_saved_searches
title: Manage saved searches
